components.role: 地面任务控制：命令受理、队列、验证、HTTP API :8090

config_source.roles: etc/roles.yaml: Operator = Command:.*, CommandHistory:.*, ReadParameter:.*, ReadPacket:.*, System:[CommandOptions]

components.role: RACCOON 代理：CCSDS USLP 帧 <-> Zenoh <-> PUS 服务 (Rust)

state_modification_zmq.note: 原生支持、未经 PUS/Yamcs 链路暴露（实验扩展前）；对 5555 直接可达即可调用

components.role: 交互日志；库 honeysat_log；应用日志落在集合 'type'（SuchaiState.py:43 的 __class__.__name__ 误用），data.context 区分事件类型 (interface_request_and_replies / eps_set_heater / eps_hk / ...)

commands.effect: 触发 EPS 遥测下传 TM(132,0): EPS_VOLTAGE/EPS_CURRENT_IN/EPS_CURRENT_OUT/EPS_TEMPERATURE
仿真器 EPS heater 开关 (HEATER_POWER=5W 功耗模型), 回 TM(132,3) 状态; 读回: FetchEPSData 功耗变化
commands.source: EXPERIMENT EXTENSION (mdb/service-eps.xml SetHeater + raccoon eps_service; patch in patches/, baseline preserved)

command_confirmation.chain: PUS TM(1,1) acceptance -> TM(1,3) start -> TM(1,7) completion success / TM(1,8) failure; Yamcs Received/Started/Complete JS verifiers 按 apid+seqcount 配对 (xtce-pus-frame-attempt2.xml:226-339)

queue_api.note: yamcs-client 1.12.0 无队列管理方法，用 REST
endpoints: POST .../queues/default/commands/{cmd}:reject (队列内拒收 = 放行前唯一取消)
queue_api.privilege: ControlCommandQueue system privilege (administrator 的 Operator 角色不具备, 实测 403; root superuser 具备)

interfaces.auth: YamlAuthModule (required), OAuth2 password grant /auth/token + Basic; administrator/Admin123

verification.mdb_consistency: 5 个活动 MDB 文件容器与源码 md5 全部一致 (2026-11-17)

known_limitations: 经 Yamcs/RACCOON 的原生命令仅 5 条查询；SetHeater 为实验扩展命令 (patches/), 评估原生行为时必须用 baseline 镜像对照
EPS 遥测为命令触发的按需下传，无周期 HK；参数缓存关闭 (parameterCache.enabled=false)，必须订阅就绪后再发令
Yamcs CORS allowOrigin=*；蜜罐 API 的 Mongo 凭证明文分布于 compose/源码
ALWAYS_REACHABLE=1 使 RACCOON 卫星可达性检查恒真
